name: Pothos
light: Medium to bright indirect; handles low light
tip: Leaves soften and droop slightly when thirsty, then perk up within hours of watering.

name: Monstera
tip: Yellowing lower leaves with wet soil usually means too much water.

name: Heartleaf philodendron
tip: Tolerant and forgiving. Curling leaves mean it wants water.

name: Snake plant
tip: Rot is the only real killer. When in doubt, wait another week.

name: ZZ plant
tip: Stores water in its rhizomes. Wrinkled stems mean it is finally thirsty.

name: Peace lily
tip: Droops dramatically when thirsty. Water then, but don't let it happen often.

name: Fiddle leaf fig
tip: Hates being moved. Brown spots in the middle of leaves usually mean overwatering.

name: Rubber plant
tip: Drops lower leaves when soil stays wet.

name: Calathea / prayer plant
dry: Top ½ in dry; keep lightly moist
tip: Crispy edges come from tap-water minerals and dry air. Use filtered or rain water.

name: Spider plant
tip: Brown tips are often fluoride in tap water, not thirst.

name: Hoya
tip: Likes being snug in its pot. Thin, wrinkly leaves mean it needs water.

name: Chinese money plant
tip: Rotate it weekly. Drooping, cupped leaves mean it is thirsty.

name: Chinese evergreen
tip: Slow grower. It drinks less than you expect.

name: Dracaena
tip: Sensitive to fluoride. Brown tips improve with filtered water.

name: Anthurium
tip: Needs airy roots. Chunky mix suits it, but soak thoroughly.

name: Alocasia
tip: May go dormant and drop leaves in winter. Water much less then.

name: Bird of paradise
tip: Split leaves are normal. Curled leaves mean thirst.

name: Boston fern
dry: Surface just dry; never let it dry out
tip: Loves humidity. A bathroom window is ideal.

name: Orchid (Phalaenopsis)
tip: Soak the pot for 10 minutes, then drain fully. Green roots mean it doesn't need water yet.

name: African violet
tip: Water from the bottom. Water on the leaves leaves spots.

name: Succulent (Echeveria etc.)
tip: Soak and dry. Soft, squishy leaves mean overwatering; wrinkly leaves mean thirst.

name: Cactus
tip: In winter, water once a month at most.

name: Aloe vera
tip: Thin, curling leaves mean thirst. Mushy base means rot.

name: Jade plant
tip: Wrinkled leaves mean water it. It does great outdoors in 10b too.

name: String of pearls
tip: Shallow roots rot fast. Use a terracotta pot and water lightly.

name: Citrus in a pot
tip: Use a citrus fertilizer. Yellow leaves with green veins mean it is short on iron or nitrogen.

name: Rose
tip: Water deeply at the base in the morning. Wet leaves invite mildew.

name: Lavender
tip: Thrives on neglect. Overwatering and rich soil kill it.

name: Rosemary
tip: Mediterranean plant. Loves 10b and hates soggy roots.

name: Bougainvillea
tip: A little drought stress means more flowers. Don't pamper it.

name: Hibiscus
tip: Very thirsty in summer heat. Dropping buds mean it dried out.

name: Geranium
tip: Yellow lower leaves mean too much water.

name: Basil
tip: Pinch the flower buds. Wilts fast in afternoon heat.

name: Mint
tip: Keep it in a pot or it takes over the yard.

name: Tomato (container)
tip: Uneven watering causes cracked fruit and blossom-end rot. Keep it steady.

name: Olive tree (pot)
tip: Drought tolerant once established. Leaves curl when thirsty.
